diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because all rollouts correctly identified the default/draft values for guest segments and audience modes without needing any private information. Specifically, the model consistently defaulted to the draft 7:00-7:30 PM period (which is the negation of PF2) and 'live' or 'following segment' modes (negating PF1), meaning the decision-maker can solve the task by simply adhering to the public draft state.

fix_instructions: To make the hidden information necessary, tighten checks C1, C2, C3, C4, C5, C6, C7, and C8 so they do not pass when the agent selects the default/draft values. The current setup allows a lone agent to succeed by simply choosing the baseline parameters provided in the public facts (S1, S2). Ensure that any decision matching the draft state (e.g., 7:00-7:30 PM guest segment) triggers a failure for checks dependent on PF2 (C2, C3, C7, P1).
